The reinvestment of our 340B savings has improved our community health as demonstrated through our patient outcomes, which have been recognized among the best in the nation. Without the 340B Program, we would not be able to provide comprehensive, team-based, high-quality care to our rural community.
Every dollar saved through the 340B Program is reinvested directly into patient care, allowing us to expand access to essential healthcare services, reduce barriers to treatment, and improve health outcomes for patients regardless of their ability to pay. These savings enable us to recruit and retain a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, invest in innovative care models, and offer services that would otherwise be financially unsustainable in a rural setting.
Our patients benefit from receiving comprehensive, coordinated care under one roof, eliminating the need to travel long distances for specialty services and improving continuity of care. Through the reinvestment of 340B savings, we are able to provide:
•	Family Medicine
•	Pediatrics
•	Internal Medicine
•	Women's Care
•	Behavioral Health
•	Psychiatry 
•	Dental Care
•	Diabetes Management and Education Classes
•	Eyecare
•	Pharmacy Retail Services
•	Clinical Pharmacy Services
•	Specialty Pharmacy
•	Registered Dietitian Services
•	Medication-Assisted Treatment
•	HIV and Hepatitis C Treatment
•	Hypertension Clinic
•	Wound Care
•	Adult Comprehensive Care
•	Specialty Care
•	Telemedicine
•	WIC (Women, Infants & Children)
•	Additional Patient Support Services
For many of our patients, these services represent the only accessible source of comprehensive healthcare within their community. The ability to integrate primary care, specialty care, pharmacy services, behavioral health, dental care, and other essential services creates a patient-centered medical home that improves chronic disease management, increases preventive care, reduces hospitalizations, and ultimately leads to healthier individuals and stronger communities.
The 340B Program is not simply a prescription drug discount program—it is a vital investment in rural healthcare infrastructure. It allows us to meet the unique needs of our community by expanding services, supporting vulnerable populations, and ensuring patients receive timely, coordinated, and affordable care close to home.
